context_for_next_testing_agent: Contacts Import/Export feature is fully functional. Backend endpoints: POST /api/contacts/import (accepts .vcf and .csv files), GET /api/contacts/export/vcard, GET /api/contacts/export/csv. All endpoints support optional filters: category (buyer/seller), status (active/lead/inactive). vCard format uses VERSION:3.0 for Apple compatibility. Frontend modals have proper data-testid attributes for testing.
